style: Use the attached images ONLY as a STYLE reference for the LINE and the flat playful editorial look — match their bold confident black ink outlines, flat colors with NO gradients and minimal shading. Do NOT copy their colors. Use instead a flat limited PASTEL palette: mint green #B6E5CF, powder blue #AFC9E8, pale butter yellow #F6E7A8, soft blush pink #F6C6DA, and black, on a PLAIN WHITE background. Draw a brand-new illustration in that style.
end: Draw NO people and no faces. Generous empty white space around the subject. Absolutely no text, no words, no letters, no numbers, no captions.

cards.prompt: Three round cells in a row, each cut open to show the identical small closed book resting inside it, every book the same. Flat and simple.
An old laboratory bench with a shallow glass dish of used cloth bandages, a corked test tube of pale grey material beside it, and a brass lamp. Flat and simple.
A simple two-pan balance tipped hard to one side: four small blocks in the light pan, twenty small blocks heaped in the heavy one. Flat and simple.
A square photographic film pinned to a board, its surface showing a dark X-shaped cross pattern of blurred spots, with a bulldog clip at the top. Flat and simple.
A double helix drawn as two ribbons winding round each other with straight rungs between them, standing upright with generous space around it. Flat and simple.
A double helix unzipped down the middle into two halves, the rungs broken apart, each half's loose ends shaped like puzzle tabs that fit only one partner. Flat and simple.
A very long fine thread being wound around a row of small round spools, the wound spools packing tightly into a small sphere at one end. Flat and simple.
A towering stack of identical printed books reaching up out of the picture, with one small open book at the foot of the stack for scale. Flat and simple.
A long horizontal ribbon running the width of the picture, with two or three very short segments of it filled in solid and all the rest left plain. Flat and simple.
Two hands drawn side by side against plain paper, one large and one small, the same shape as each other, fingers spread. Flat and simple.
